manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: 20 fresh complete property assignments, five per missing-value form
manifest.selection: Every careful-English control carries the form's complete existence, applicability, and deliberate-removal commitments; the marked arm changes only that expansion.
manifest.method: Per tokenizer, compute marked minus careful-English token count for every pair, average all 20 equally, and report the maximum tokenizer mean as least favourable.
